postSubject: Six. Six games. (Seven if you count World) That's five done and another (presumably) on the way.I'd like to take a moment and ask Scott how he feels.Scott, how do you feel?You've made such a huge impact on us, on all of us, on the people who want to make video games, heck, just create something in general, you're such a huge inspiration to everyone.But, and this is an honest question here, are you tired of returning to Freddy?Are you tired of being in the Fazbear shadow, working to appease the people who cry for more?Now, me, I love these games, I could keep playing them till literally FNaF 57.But do you love them?Are they still a blessing, or a curse, something that weighs you down instead of lifts you up?Do you want to end the series and do something different?I personally think that FNaF 6 should be the last game in the main series, not because of us, but because of you.I know I'm guessing here, but I know that as a creator myself, it is hard to keep going, sometimes you feel like these things hold you back.Sorry if I made this long, but I will repeat, I think that FNaF 6 should be the FINAL game in the franchise.Not for our sakes, for Scott's.If I'm guessing incorrectly, I apologize.
